newsitem.title: USA: CWM Mortgage sets Q4 div of $0.40/shr.
newsitem.headline: CWM Mortgage sets Q4 div of $0.40/shr.

text.p: CWM Mortgage Holdings declared a cash dividend of $0.40 per share for the fourth quarter, payable March 3 to shareholders of record on January 31.
It paid a cash dividend of $0.35 per share for the comparable quarter in 1995.

During the fourth quarter, the company purchased $952 million of jumbo and non-conforming mortgage loans and $46 million of subprime mortgage loans through its third party lending operations, which are primarily conducted through Independent National Mortgage Corporation (Indy Mac). Also during the fourth quarter, the company sold loans totaling $713 million, in the form of real estate mortgage investment conduit (REMIC) securities. CWM's equity in earnings of Indy Mac totaled $7.5 million in the fourth quarter of both 1996 and 1995.

Indy Mac's Manufactured Housing Division purchased $35 million of manufactured housing loans during the fourth quarter of 1996, up 30 percent from the net $27 million purchased in the third quarter, excluding a bulk purchase of $27 million.

Manufactured housing loans held for sale totaled $101 million at December 31, 1996. It is the Company's intention to securitize these loans once sufficient volumes have been accumulated. Indy Mac's Manufactured Housing Division was formed in December 1995 to provide financing to consumers who are purchasing or refinancing a new or used manufactured home.

The Builder Division of Construction Lending Corp of America (CLCA), which provides tract construction, builder custom home, model home and certain condominium loan financing on a nationwide basis to builders, issued $201 million of new commitments during the fourth quarter of 1996, representing a 111 percent increase over the fourth quarter of 1995. Total tract construction and builder custom home loans outstanding at December 31, 1996 were $243 million, up 290 percent compared to $62 million at December 31, 1995. In addition, the Builder Division's model home loan and condominium loan principal balances outstanding were $104 million at December 31, 1996.
